title: SCOPE Before You Sample: Conformal Scores Guide Posterior Exploration for Fast and Calibrated Bayesian Predictive Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.17146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian predictive regions account for parameter uncertainty but can be poorly calibrated under model misspecification, even with expensive full MCMC. Cheaper approximations such as variational inference reduce the cost but often yield less accurate predictive distributions. We propose SCOPE (Score-guided Conformal Posterior Exploration), which retains the predictive quality of full MCMC while achieving calibrated coverage at a fraction of its cost. The key observation is that a prediction region can depend on the posterior mainly through a few parameter directions that move the region's boundary, and these are generally not the directions of largest posterior variance. SCOPE gives nonconformity scores a new role in guiding posterior computation: score gradients on a held-out guide set, weighted toward the target boundary, identify the relevant directions. translated_title: 先SCOPE再采样：共形分数引导后验探索，实现快速且校准良好的贝叶斯预测推断
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯预测区域考虑了参数不确定性，但在模型设定错误的情况下，即使使用昂贵的高精度MCMC（马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛）方法，其覆盖率校准也可能很差。变分推断等更廉价的近似方法虽然降低了计算成本，但往往导致预测分布的准确性下降。我们提出了SCOPE（Score-guided Conformal Posterior Exploration，分数引导的共形后验探索），它在保留完整MCMC预测质量的同时，只需其成本的一小部分即可实现校准良好的覆盖率。关键观察是：预测区域对后验的依赖主要体现在少数几个会移动区域边界的参数方向上，而这些方向通常并不是后验方差最大的方向。SCOPE赋予非一致性分数一个新的角色——引导后验计算：在留出的引导集上计算分数梯度，并向目标边界加权，从而识别出相关方向。MCMC在该子空间中进行探索，同时结合一个廉价的投影变分近似。
tldr: 提出SCOPE方法，利用共形非一致性分数的梯度识别影响预测区域边界的关键参数方向，引导MCMC在这一低维子空间中探索，从而以远低于完整MCMC的成本获得保留MCMC预测质量且校准良好的贝叶斯预测推断。
en_tdlr: SCOPE uses conformal nonconformity-score gradients to identify the few parameter directions that govern a prediction region's boundary, guiding MCMC exploration in this low-dimensional subspace to achieve full-MCMC predictive quality with calibrated coverage at a fraction of the cost.
